content: {"summary":"Inventory-service pods see intermittent DNS failures while datastore VMs remain healthy, indicating the two authoritative internal‑dns servers are returning different answers for the same name.","likely_cause":"One authoritative DNS server lacked the `inventory-db-01.prod.internal` record due to an incomplete zone rollout, causing the servers to disagree.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Pods intermittently log “no such host” because the DNS servers disagree.","evidence_ids":["RB-020#13","RB-020#3"],"quote":"inventory-service-01 and inventory-service-02 logged `no such host` intermittently"},{"text":"Pods see whichever answer was cached last when servers disagree.","evidence_ids":["RB-020#3"],"quote":"pods see whichever answer was cached last"},{"text":"VM‑based services are unaffected because they always query internal‑dns‑01 first unless it fails.","evidence_ids":["RB-020#2"],"quote":"VMs follow internal-dns-01's answers unless it is down or failing"},{"text":"The missing record on one server caused the disagreement during the March 2026 rollout.","evidence_ids":["RB-020#1"],"quote":"the new file was missing `inventory-db-01.prod.internal`"},{"text":"To prove the disagreement, query each DNS server directly and compare SOA serials.","evidence_ids":["RB-020#7"],"quote":"Read the `status:` in each header and compare the SOA serials"}],"next_checks":["Run `dig @10.0.0.53 inventory-db-01.prod.internal +norecurse` and `dig @10.0.0.54 inventory-db-01.prod.internal +norecurse` and note any difference in answers.","Compare SOA serials with `dig @10.0.0.53 prod.internal SOA +short` and `dig @10.0.0.54 prod.internal SOA +short`.","Inspect the zone files on both DNS VMs for the presence of `inventory-db-01.prod.internal` (e.g., `grep -n \"inventory-db-01\" /etc/coredns/zones/prod.internal.db`).","Check CoreDNS logs on the server returning NXDOMAIN to confirm the missing record."]}
